title: Steam + RustDesk = Complete Organism Nervous System
thesis: Steam and RustDesk together form the COMPLETE communications, relay, VoIP, friends, input, and visual control layer for the organism. No external services needed. Valve is a sovereign parent — they built the infrastructure, open-sourced it, and we use it as our nervous system.

eastGate.role: BRAIN — Steam host, ASF, relay origin

northGate.role: HEART — Steam Remote Play receiver (port was open earlier, rebooting)

deckGate.role: DISPLAY — Big Picture, ouroboros showing, CEF controllable

frameGate.role: 4TH EYE — SteamVR, 11 CEF tabs, VR overlays, nunchucks, camera

blueGate.role: WINDOWS — Steam only, ICMP blocked, :27036 open

grapheneGate.role: HYBRID BONE — Steam Community app on Android

swiftGate.role: ASLEEP — NZXT H1 V2, has Steam

steam_provides.remote_play: Stream desktop/games between ANY Steam nodes. NAT traversal, encryption, UDP.
steam_provides.voice_chat: Encrypted VoIP between Steam friends. No Discord/Zoom needed.
steam_provides.friends_list: Identity + presence for all gates with Steam accounts.
steam_provides.remote_play_together: Shared sessions, multiple viewers, shared input.
steam_provides.steam_input: Universal controller mapping across devices and sessions.
steam_provides.steamvr: VR overlay system, CEF browser tabs, OpenVR API.
steam_provides.steam_link: HDMI relay protocol (deckGate was originally a Steam Link display).

eastGate.role: RELAY HUB — all traffic routes through

northGate.role: Config sent via pony express, awaiting Kevin

grapheneGate.role: APK ready but not installed yet

rustdesk_provides.remote_desktop: Full visual control of any node from any other node.
rustdesk_provides.relay: hbbs/hbbr on eastGate — all nodes can find each other.
rustdesk_provides.identity: bingoCube identity system — consistent IDs across mesh.
rustdesk_provides.p2p: Direct peer-to-peer when on same LAN, relay fallback for WAN.

combined_nervous_system.relay: RustDesk hbbs/hbbr (visual relay hub on eastGate)
combined_nervous_system.identity: Steam accounts + bingoCube IDs + Forgejo accounts
combined_nervous_system.streaming: Steam Remote Play + Valve 6GHz dongle (after reboot)
combined_nervous_system.ar_vr: SteamVR + WiFi lighthouses + Frame camera + Pixel sensors

valve_as_sovereign_parent.open_software: SteamOS = Arch Linux, drivers in-kernel, scripts on GitHub
